questions.prompt: Which operator requires both Boolean operands to be true?
questions.explanation: Logical AND, written &&, is true only when both operands are true.

questions.prompt:
What is printed?
val amount = 60
println(if (amount <= 50) "A" else "B")
questions.explanation: The condition is false, so the else branch produces B.

questions.prompt: Spot the incorrect operator in this equality check: if (status = "Ready")
questions.explanation: A single equals sign is assignment syntax; equality comparison uses ==.
